Thanks — quick technical outline (canary runbook highlights):

- Staging prep: mirror prod config in our Canary VPC; seed with synthetic traffic and key-value cache snapshots.
- Traffic shape: step ramp
  - 0–4h: 2% steady
  - 4–12h: 2% -> 6% linear ramp
  - 12–48h: 6% -> 10% linear ramp (monitoring windows at 4h, 12h, 24h, 48h)
- Health gates (fail triggers = immediate rollback):
  - 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m
  - Error percentiles: p95 latency > 1.5x baseline for 15m
  - Token-level quality regression: automated eval set shows >3% drop in key intent accuracy
- Rollback steps: immediate traffic divert to previous model variant, revoke temporary keys, notify on-call SRE and customer ops.
- Automation: all ramps controlled by our canary controller with manual override.

I attached a PDF with the timeblocks and monitoring checkpoints. I can convert this to their runbook format tomorrow.
